sentences.text: Shri Akhilendra Singh - Government Advocate for the res
Heard on IA No.23233/2024, which is first application filed under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail to the appellant Rajesh Ahirwar.

Appellant stands convicted vide judgment dated 28.04.2023 passed by First ASJ, Niwari District Tikamgarh M.P. in ST No.59/2018 for offence under Section 366, 370, 376(2)(n) and 376(D) of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 05 years & fine Rs.1000/-; RI for 07 years & fine Rs.1000/-, RI for 20 years & fine Rs.1000/- and RI for 20 years & fine Rs.1000/- each for respective offences with default stipulation.

As per the case of the prosecution, allegation against the appellant is that he alongwith other co-accused persons abducted the prosecutrix, committed rape with her several times and also tried to sell her.
On the basis of the aforesaid, offence as mentioned above has been registered against the accused persons.
It submitted by the counsel for the appellant that the appellant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
He has not committed any offence as alleged.
It is also submitted that DNA is found negative and as per MLC no internal or external injury has been found on the person of the prosecutrix.
There is no other evidence to support the case of the prosecution.

Since the appeal is of the year 2023, final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future and the 2 CRA-7350-2023 appellant has incarcerated in jail about 03 years, therefore, it is prayed that the remaining jail sentence may be suspended and appellant may be released on bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State supported the impugned judgment and prays for rejection of application for suspension of sentence.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Having considered the rival submissions coupled with the fact that DNA is negative and MLC indicates no internal or external Rajesh Ahirwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157010526/
1 injury on the person of the prosecutrix; the appellant is in jail for about 03 years and final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future, therefore, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, IA No.23233/2024 is allowed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is directed that subject to depositing the entire fine amount, if already not deposited, the substantive jail sentence of appellant shall remain suspended till the final disposal of the appeal and he be released on bail, on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court, for his appearance before the concerned trial Court firstly on 05.02.2025, and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the said Court in this regard.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.
